h: INEC reportedly sets a timeline for deciding the fate of Pantami's and Gwarzo's governorship candidacies
p: INEC has reportedly indicated when Isa Ali Pantami in Gombe and Aminu Gwarzo in Kano will learn whether their governorship bids stand. Both names were missing from the commission's final list earlier this month, and their parties have disputed the omission. Pantami has also vowed to expose those he says are plotting against his bid.
more: Both names were left off the final governorship candidates list published on 10 October.
Their parties insist the two men remain their candidates in Gombe and Kano.
The governorship and presidential elections are scheduled for 6 February 2027.
